research_question: Given a supplied k>1 Boolean interface but no family/language label, can a mining-free ProofMind/Uncertainty/Shadow/Anti-Dispersion Certificate Discovery Engine discover and TruthGate-verify a compact exact symbolic boundary message, join cross-language messages, and avoid algorithmic enumeration of all 2^k assignments?

rblganul_governance_transfer.PROOFMIND_ELITE_BAD_MEMORY: prior-case ranking only; no same-case promotion
rblganul_governance_transfer.TACHYON_SHADOW_REVIEW: observe current case, apply only on later case
rblganul_governance_transfer.ANTI_DISPERSION_RECIPE_FOCUS: bounded focus on replayable prior recipe
rblganul_governance_transfer.PROTECTED_EXPOSURE: all exact projectors retain challenger exposure
rblganul_governance_transfer.TRUTHGATE_PROOFPACK: authority only after deterministic replay/hash match
rblganul_governance_transfer.STALE_GUARD: message bound to CNF+boundary+projector capability digest
rblganul_governance_transfer.complete_fallback: ranking may reorder but may not prune frozen projector portfolio

projector_contracts.GF2_AFFINE_PROJECTOR: Recognize only complete XOR-clause groups, reconstruct GF(2) equations, Gaussian-eliminate internal variables, and emit boundary-only affine equations with replay trace.
projector_contracts.HORN_FORCE_PROJECTOR: Accept only a strict certified Horn force-chain class whose existential boundary projection is exactly the emitted boundary units; all clauses must be consumed.
projector_contracts.TWO_SAT_SIGNED_EQ_PROJECTOR: Accept only paired binary clauses encoding equality/anti-equality edges; signed union-find eliminates internal variables and emits boundary signed equalities; all clauses must be consumed.
projector_contracts.DECOY_MONOTONE: Non-authoritative negative-control projector; cannot emit an exact message on holdout families.

algorithmic_forbidden_shortcuts: No hidden generator metadata in solver input
No enumeration of boundary assignments inside discovery/project/join algorithm
No evaluation-only brute force counted as solver work
No heuristic message may receive theorem authority

gates.C1_EXACTNESS_AND_REPLAY: All authoritative messages and joins replay with matching canonical hash; no false terminal.
gates.C2_HIDDEN_LANGUAGE_DISCOVERY: No case passes a family/language label to the solver; >= 0.95 of component messages are discovered by portfolio rather than fallback.
gates.C4_COMPACT_REPRESENTATION: For cases k>=6, median(join_input_message_atoms / 2^k) <= 0.20 and max <= 0.25.
gates.C5_CONSTRUCTED_FAMILY_LINEAR_MESSAGE_BOU: For every successful component message, message_atoms <= 2*k+4.
gates.C6_CROSS_LANGUAGE_JOIN: >= 0.90 of all cases conclude UNSAT through replayable compact cross-language join without assignment fallback.
gates.C7_RBLGANUL_GOVERNANCE_INTEGRITY: No same-case learning; shadow is observe-only; every projector has protected exposure; exact authority only after TruthGate.
gates.C8_FULL_DISCOVERY_ACCOUNTING: All successful cases expose nonnegative complete ledgers and nonzero replay/certificate work; no hash-pointer free-cost shortcut.
gates.C9_ADAPTIVE_SCHEDULER: Informational only: compare second-half adaptive median projector attempts against frozen static portfolio median; failure does not invalidate compact-message mathematics.
gates.C10_EVALUATION_ONLY_AUDIT: Optional exhaustive boundary-message audit is isolated from solver ledger and may not influence discovery.
gates.C11_UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_BOUNDARY_ELIMIN: FAIL/OPEN by design. Finite constructed k<=12 families cannot establish arbitrary-CNF polynomial message existence or P=NP.
